questions.question: Hemant buys a dozen eggs for Rs. 5.50 per egg. While carrying them, two eggs wasted when fall down and get damaged. He sells the balanced eggs at Rs. 7.70 per egg. Find the net profit earned by him in the overall deal.
questions.questionHtml: Hemant buys a dozen eggs for Rs. 5.50 per egg. While carrying them, two eggs wasted when fall down and get damaged. He sells the balanced eggs at Rs. 7.70 per egg. Find the net profit earned by him in the overall deal.
questions.solution:
Hemant buys a dozen eggs for Rs. 5.50 per egg.

1 dozen = 12 units

Price of 1 dozen eggs = Rs. (12 × 5.50) = Rs. 66

While carrying them, two eggs wasted when fall down and get damaged. He sells the balanced eggs at Rs. 7.70 per egg

No. of eggs left after 2 egg gets broken is 10.

So price of 10 eggs with Rs. 7.70 per unit is Rs. 77

Profit = Rs. (77 – 66) = Rs. 11

Hence, the net profit earned by him in the overall deal is Rs. 11.

questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make given equation correct? 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128
questions.questionHtml: Which two signs should be interchanged to make given equation correct? 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128
questions.solution:
1) × and ÷

Given equation: 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128

After interchanging ‘× and ÷’, we get:

L.H.S = 121 × 11 + 54 - 9 ÷ 3

= 1331 + 54 - 3

= 1385 - 3

= 1382 ≠ R.H.S

2) + and ×

Given equation: 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128

After interchanging ‘+ and ×’, we get:

L.H.S = 121 ÷ 11 × 54 - 9 + 3

= 11 × 54 - 9 + 3

= 594 - 9 + 3

= 597 - 9

= 588 ≠ R.H.S

3) ÷ and -

Given equation: 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128

After interchanging ‘÷ and -’, we get:

L.H.S = 121 - 11 + 54 ÷ 9 × 3

= 121 - 11 + 6 × 3

= 121 - 11 + 18

= 139 - 11

= 128 = R.H.S

4) + and -

Given equation: 121 ÷ 11 + 54 - 9 × 3 = 128

After interchanging ‘+ and -’, we get:

L.H.S = 121 ÷ 11 - 54 + 9 × 3

= 11 - 54 + 27

= 38 - 54

= - 16 ≠ R.H.S

Hence, ‘÷ and -‘ is the correct answer

questions.question: In which state The Jaugada Rock Edict of Asoka is located?
questions.questionHtml: In which state The Jaugada Rock Edict of Asoka is located?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is Option 2 i.e Odisha.

  • Jaugada is an ancient fort that served as a Mauryan fortified capital of the Kalinga province.
  • Jaugada is located in Odisha.
  • In Odia language, Jau means Lac, and Gada means fort. Jaugada thus means a Lac fort.
  • Jaugada is also known as Jatudurga.
  • The rock edict inscriptions, engraved in Prakrit language in Brahmi script, have information about the better administrative policies based on Ashoka's humanitarian consideration.
  • It is a protected heritage monument now under the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI).

Key Points

  • With the help of Chanakya (Vishnugupta/ Kautilya), Chandragupta Maurya defeated Dhana Nanda (322 BCE) and founded the Mauryan Dynasty.
  • Chanakya encouraged Chandragupta Maurya and his army to take over the throne of Magadha.
  • His vast empire included Bihar, Bengal, Deccan (except modern Kerala, Tamilnadu, and parts of Northeast India), Eastern Afghanistan, Baluchistan, and the area west of the Indus river.

 Important Points

bindusara

  • Chandragupta was succeeded by his son Bindusara.
  • Bindusara ruled for approximately 25-26 years and his succession was disputed which ultimately gave India a great king called Asoka.

Ashoka

  • Asoka was the third and the greatest of the Mauryan rulers.
  • Ashoka is referred to as Ashokavardhana.

Kunala

  • Kunala was the son of Emperor Ashoka and Queen Padmavati and the presumptive heir to Ashoka.

    • It is used to produce very hard alloys for fountain pen tips, instrument pivots, needles, and electrical contacts.

questions.question: What is the velocity of sound in air?
questions.questionHtml: What is the velocity of sound in air?
questions.solution:
CONCEPT:

Sound: 

  • A local disturbance whose propagation is facilitated by the collisions between particles, this disturbance propagates in a longitudinal wave, imagine one molecule hitting the next molecule, and then that molecule hitting the next, and so forth.
    • It is a mechanical wave that needs a medium to travel.
    • The speed of sound is maximum in solid then it is in liquid and slowest in gases.

EXPLANATION:

  • The speed of sound is actually the speed of transmission of a small disturbance through a medium i.e the rate at which sound travels through a medium.
  • Sound cannot travel in a vacuum as there is no medium for the sound to travel through.
  • The speed of sound in air is about 332 meters per second.
  • Sound travels fastest in solids (such as steel), then liquid, and then least in gases.

questions.question: What is the remainder when we divide 5 70 + 7 70 by 74?
questions.questionHtml: What is the remainder when we divide 5<sup>70</sup> + 7<sup>70</sup> by 74?
questions.solution:
Concept Used:

If n is odd then, an + bn is divisible by (a + b)

Calculation:

Here given,

570 + 770

⇒ 2535 + 4935

Here n = 35, which is an odd number.

⇒ an + bn is divisible by (a + b)

⇒ 2535 + 4935 is divisible by (25 + 49) = 74

⇒ (52)35 + (72)35 is divisible by 74

⇒ 570 + 770 is divisible by 74

So, we can say 570 + 770 is completely divisibly by 74.

So, the remainder is 0.

Additional Information

1. If n is even then, an - bn is divisible by both (a + b) and (a - b)

2. If n is odd then, an - bn is divisible by (a - b)

Average = sum of the elements/number of elements

Let the number of students in section B be x.

Let the average score of students in A be y.

Nubmer of students in section A = 125% of B = (5/4) × x

We know, x + (5/4) x = 90

Or, x = 90 × 4/9 = 40

Then, the number of students in section A = 50

Total score of students in section A = 50 × y 

Total score of students in section B = 40 × 120% × y

Total score of students in section B = 40 × (6y/5) = 48y

Total score of all students of A and B = 90 × 49 = 4410

50y + 48y = 98y = 4410 

Or, y = 4410/98 = 45

Thus, the average score of students in class A id 45.

  

Let the number of students in section B be 4
